_note: Random encounters on the world map (rules/wandering.ts, house rules). chance = per step off the road (a zone may set its own), roadChance = on roads and bridges (0 = roads are safe), grace = quiet steps after an encounter. Zones by distance (squares) to the nearest town, cave, ruin or quest site, hidden ones included; the first zone that fits wins. Each zone picks one of its dialogs (quests.json) and sets the fight's difficulty. share = most monsters as a share of the party size (1 = one per character).
